mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced interest rate pressures on equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or FEDFUNDS show no sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing below 4.5% predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as lower unemployment signals labor market strength and growth potential.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or the crossing does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (employment) over the past month signal rising demand, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST increase, or the increase in either proxy does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO crossing below 105 predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as supply constraints drive inflationary pressures and equity gains.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses below 105, or the crossing does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced interest rate pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during a monetary easing cycle, or FEDFUNDS show no sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE coupled with an increase in PAYEMS predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as conflicting labor trends signal potential growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases while PAYEMS increases over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases, or the movement in either proxy does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 over the past 3 months predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as growing economic activity boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 shows a sustained increase, or the increase does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in INDPRO (supply) and FEDFUNDS (monetary) over the past month predict positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as dual pressures boost equity performance.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and FEDFUNDS both decrease over the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both INDPRO and FEDFUNDS decrease, or the decrease in either proxy does not occur.
